items.title: 豆包“工作任务”升级，支持手机远程操控电脑
items.raw_excerpt: 近日豆包发布产品更新，“工作任务”模式新增手机远程控制电脑功能。同一账号授权后，用户在手机端下达任务指令，可以由已连接的电脑端读取本地文件、操作软件完成执行，进度和结果实时回传手机，帮助用户在通勤、离开工位等各类场景中自动执行任务，提升效率。   今年6月豆包上线“工作任务”模式，AI 可在授权后直接操作本地电脑和浏览器。此次更新把操控任务扩展到手机端，支持关联多台电脑，可跨设备调取文件。豆包官号演示的案例显示，外出时远程让电脑找到桌面文件、转成 PDF 回传；通勤途中让电脑继续未完成的数据分析、生成图表发到手机；所需文件分散在工作和家庭两台电脑时，分别调取后合并修改。 使用该功能需在豆包官网下载最新的“豆包电脑版”， 并将手机端豆包App更新至最新版，在“工作任务”模式中点击“云电脑”，并在对话运行环境中选择“添加新的本地电脑”完成授权。

Doubao recently released a product update, adding a mobile remote control feature for computers to its "Work Tasks" mode. After authorization under the same account, users can issue task commands from their phone, and the connected computer can read local files and operate software to execute the tasks, with progress and results sent back to the phone in real time. This helps users automatically execute tasks in scenarios such as commuting or being away from their desks, improving efficiency.

In June this year, Doubao launched the "Work Tasks" mode, allowing AI to directly operate the local computer and browser after authorization. This update extends control tasks to mobile devices, supports linking multiple computers, and enables cross-device file retrieval. Demo cases shown on Doubao's official account include: remotely having the computer find desktop files, convert them to PDF, and send them back while away; continuing unfinished data analysis during a commute and sending generated charts to the phone; and when files are scattered across work and home computers, retrieving them separately and merging them for editing.

To use this feature, users need to download the latest "Doubao PC Version" from the official website and update the Doubao app on their phone to the latest version. In "Work Tasks" mode, click "Cloud Computer" and select "Add new local computer" in the conversation runtime environment to complete authorization.

excerpt_i18n.en: On August 17, Zhou Hongyi, founder of 360 Group, released an all-staff letter. Titled "Driving Business Innovation and Organizational Transformation with Leadership," the letter clearly stated that during the company's transition to an AI Native organization, managers at all levels are the first responsible persons for cultivating super individuals and building super teams, and bluntly said, "This is not an ordinary upgrade of cadre leadership, but 360's re-entrepreneurship with AI." It is understood that this all-staff letter is a further upgrade of 360's advancement of the "All in Agent" strategy. Previously, Zhou Hongyi had publicly stated on multiple occasions that enterprise AI transformation must begin with managers. Over the past year, 360 has continuously promoted the implementation of AI in scenarios such as product R&D, business operations, and organizational collaboration. Multiple teams have successfully run AI-native practices, with significant improvements in R&D efficiency and business innovation capability. This all-staff letter further clarifies these explorations into unified actions for all managers. In the letter, Zhou Hongyi put forward three clear requirements to managers at all levels: vigorously promote innovation and transformation to accelerate breakthroughs in business and products; fully advance organizational reshaping so that managers shift from "approval machines" to "coaches and commanders of super individuals"; learn and iterate, personally engage, and first evolve themselves into "super individuals" proficient in AI. What attracted even more external attention was the "three assignments" proposed in the letter. Zhou Hongyi required that every cadre must lead their team to deliver practical results.
